svg.title: Verification status by component
svg.text: Each crate sits where it runs. The colour is what is guaranteed about it; the bar splits its lines into proof, spec and exec.
the kernel and the network; the only process with I/O
KERNEL owns all browser state and decides every change to it
NETWORK parses and checks every byte off the wire: HTTP, DNS, TLS and certificates
SHELLS move bytes between the OS and the kernel, and decide nothing
2270 of 2283 broken specs caught by a theorem
13 more (crypto) broke only a proof script: no theorem became false, so they are not counted as coverage.
21 axioms: proofs taken from other verified libraries
p384, 6: The trust boundary of the field: every call into fiat-crypto, each one axiom.
crypto, 15: The trust boundary: every call into libcrux, each one axiom.
Each sits in its crate's axioms.rs with its justification; the checker rejects any other assumption.
Panic-free · Kani, on all inputs to a bound
Memory safe · safe Rust and tests
